# Unifitz

> Unifitz runs live, instructor-led online fitness classes for women over Zoom — Zumba, Yoga, Strength and Meditation — in small cohorts where the instructor knows each member by name. Built for Indian-origin women aged 30–50 in the United States, with a weekly timetable shown in the viewer's timezone.

- Format: live two-way video classes on Zoom, women-only, small cohorts; cameras optional
- Schedule: live classes six days a week (Monday–Saturday), morning and evening cohorts
- Programs: PCOS/PCOD Care, Weight-Loss Intensive, Post-40 Strength, Postpartum Return (general fitness, not medical treatment)
- Pricing (USD per month): Starter $39, Regular $59, Starter + Diet $69, Complete $89; quarterly billing saves 12%; cancel anytime
- Free option: one free live masterclass seat, no card required
- Based in Jaipur, Rajasthan, India
- Contact: hello@unifitz.in, WhatsApp +91 73878 46841
